youtube_title: Jesus... I Eat Lunch On The Staircase Every Day 🍱 | Matthew 25:35 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

He eats lunch on the office staircase every day and calls it a choice, but really no one ever asked him to join.

He: Jesus... I eat lunch on the office staircase every day. 🍱
He: The team goes to the food court. Nobody asks. So I stopped waiting to be asked.
Jesus: You call it a choice. But you rehearsed that line the whole walk up.
He: So what? I like the quiet. It's not that deep.
Jesus: Quiet you chose is rest. Quiet that chose you is loneliness.
Jesus: You don't need the whole team. Be the one who asks first.

“For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,”
Matthew 25:35 (BSB)

You don't need the whole team. Be the one who asks first.

💬 Who at your office eats alone? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
